name: Change risk review
description: Review a repository change with independent security and code-quality lenses, then produce one findings report.

tasks.verification: Findings identify severity, source locations, evidence, and uncertainty.
Findings identify correctness and maintenance defects with supporting source evidence.

tasks.execution_reason: The root verifies independent lens evidence and prepares the single phase checkpoint.
tasks.verification: Deduplicate findings, map every criterion, preserve unresolved gaps and actual reviewer identities.

acceptance_scenarios: Two independent lens results must be joined and accepted before synthesis.
The final report covers every bound criterion and preserves unknown results.
Execution creates only the bound output files; it does not change source.
A second invocation gets fresh run identity, bindings and checkpoint decisions.
Unavailable native workers block required coverage instead of changing it to serial work.

criteria.statement: Identify security and correctness risks in the bound change.

preview_binding.route_summary: One standalone Engineering visit; two independent native lens tasks, then root synthesis and the normal checkpoint.
unresolved_before_run: Resolve refs to immutable commits and match the selected checkout.
Discover relevant dependency/test files and bind the complete exact read scope.
Verify installed role/lens availability and runtime contract fingerprints.
Bind real user request, worker capacity, runtime-owned scope/task evidence paths and output location.
preview_binding.side_effects: None. This JSON is an illustrative proposed format, not accepted by the current CLI.

runtime_requirements.resolution: Verify supported contracts and pin the actually loaded runtime and capability fingerprints when binding.
